content.title: Mercury Strengthens Defense Hardware Against Cyber Threats
content.summary: Mercury Systems Inc. (NASDAQ:MRCY) has joined forces with Nightwing to bolster the cybersecurity of Mercury’s mission hardware. The partnership aims to integrate Nightwing’s cyber resiliency tools into Mercury’s edge computing systems, which are used in defense and intelligence operations. The Massachusetts-based defense technology firm said the alliance will deliver pre-integrated cybersecurity and anti-tamper protections to enhance system integrity during operation.
